probes.name: baseline
probes.hypothesis: Reproduce retained NonMatching reconstruction under canonical flags.

probes.name: sequential_postincrement
probes.hypothesis: Sequential advancing stores may change pointer induction lowering and allocator interference while folding to the same store offsets.

probes.name: inner_postincrement_test
probes.hypothesis: The induction value is unused by stores; moving its increment into the test may change loop canonicalization and lifetime of the invariant bound.

probes.name: outer_do_while
probes.hypothesis: Express the guaranteed two outer iterations directly as do/while to change preheader construction without changing store behavior.

probes.name: outer_update_expression
probes.hypothesis: Move the pointer reset to the outer-loop update expression to change the latch IR feeding pointer allocation.

probes.name: inner_inclusive_bound
probes.hypothesis: Equivalent inclusive trip-count expression introduces count-minus-one before unrolling; this differs from manually introducing the prior count-minus-eight bound.
